O*NET® Database Releases Archive
The current production release of the O*NET database is 31.0; see our
O*NET Database
page for more information.
Current and previous releases as well as transitional releases of the database can be obtained below.
For summary update information, see
O*NET Occupation Update Summary
.  For details about each release in the archive, refer to:
O*NET Database Release Notes (30.3 and later)
O*NET Database Release Notes (4.0 to 30.3)
Researchers conducting longitudinal studies: see
O*NET Longitudinal Data Updates
(XLSX).
Creative Commons licensed
All versions of the O*NET Database are available under a Creative Commons license. See the
Database license page
for more information.

view chart for 2017–2026
On average, 843 O*NET occupations were updated yearly between 2017–2025.
In 2026, 891 O*NET occupations have been updated year-to-date through August.
The next database update is currently scheduled for November 2026.
Totals have been adjusted based on the current O*NET-SOC 2019 taxonomy. Totals reflect the 923 data-collection-level occupations.
Updates include a range of categories across the
O*NET Content Model
